phase_name: Pin the member with acceptance, paired-negative, and fail-open fixtures

objectives.description: Append Case 15 (own-directory acceptance), Case 16 (paired negative), and Case 17 (fail-open across missing/empty/malformed file_scope) to test-git-commit-phase.sh
Red-proof the new fixtures against a splice-stripped scratch copy; run bash -n/shellcheck and the full suite
objectives.note: Red-proof against a splice-stripped scratch copy of git-commit-phase.sh showed Case 15 FAILED on both assertions (the drop warning fires, and a 'scope excursion' row is written to issues.jsonl) and Case 16 FAILED on its own-directory assertion, confirming both cases are genuinely red without the Phase 1 fix. Case 17 passed unchanged in both configurations, confirming the fail-open posture is independent of the new splice. IMPORTANT CORRECTION to the live-symptom framing: empirically, the own-task-directory report file still LANDS in HEAD even without the fix, because stage_paths' unconditional task_dir/ seed (line 201) already stages the whole directory recursively regardless of files_touched filtering. The pre-fix defect is therefore a spurious drop WARNING plus a spurious 'scope excursion' issue-log entry for a legitimate own-directory path -- noise and incorrect classification, not an actual silent omission from the commit in this configuration. This matches the acceptance criteria's own phrasing ('zero scope-excursion issue records emitted for it') and is recorded in Case 15/16's own code comments and will be carried into the Phase 3 doc record and the summary.
